name: Monty Hall game
description: Monty Hall problem is a popular probability puzzle based on a television game show and named after its host, Monty Hall. In this Monty Hall game, There will be three closed doors and you will be given a choice to choose one of them. Behind one of the doors, there is a car and behind the other doors, goats. The host knows about the placement of the car and goats. After you choose a door, the host opens one of the other two doors which has a goat. Now, you can either stick with your original choice of door or you can switch.
